admission.calendar: Parse native explicit UTC clock bounds and exact fixed sbatch --test-only reply from reviewed capture program. Exact profile.rendered_sbatch_argv plus --test-only, node/jobname/script SHA/CPU/memory/wall match reviewed physical profile and quote; no shell/wrap/arbitrary flags. Native Slurm timestamp must be explicit UTC/offset and its projected start+whole quoted wall+profile reserve fit fixed profile window. At actual issuer time, latest first submission lies inside original scope and current fixed profile; maximum submission horizon255 seconds and observation age90 seconds. Unsupported/unparseable/missing reply or incomplete identity refuses. A test-only number is not an actual job.

admission.promotion: Finalizer requires actual H5 stdout equals candidate; PID and birth match; accepted record is candidate with accepted status and actual_accept_guard. No fabricated guard; Root issuer command itself requires real H5 context before supplied metadata.
admission.resource: Parse raw native scontrol node reply. Exact requested node; scheduler RealMemory-AllocMem >= quote memory_MiB, requested CPUs available within qualified physical profile. FreeMem never used for schedulable RAM. Independent actual stage-start witness must also prove actual job cgroup/core/SMT/affinity/RAM/storage and source/RO gates.
admission.resource_pair: actual_resource_observation has closed {result,guard}; calendar pair may reference same actual capture (charged once); validate original H8 flags, exact stdout/PID/birth and fixed control capture program source, not a reported status alone
admission.startup_baseline: qualified_startup_baseline is a separately independently reviewed EXPECTED immutable startup baseline plan, not already accepted native-runtime qualification. Status PASS_REVIEWED_R203_EXPECTED_STARTUP_BASELINE_PLAN. It binds node, startup Python, fixed source/dependency/exec inventory, read-only code/toolchain/runtime roots and facility policy. Native pre-exec exact hash verification plus immutable backing is required; actual source/physical startup capture must realize and independently verify the plan before any payload release. Missing facility/baseline facts refuses; do not demand an already-earned new ABI qualification to start metadata-only bootstrap.

Duplicate paths, mismatches, sources outside requested job root and undeclared metadata refuse.

Native env TZ=UTC date; exact node scontrol; exact sbatch --test-only for admission only; exact owned-job scontrol/sacct plus exact whitelisted job-owned metadata cat/sha256sum for other modes. No remote interpreter, global census, node sweep, other jobs, numerical data or arbitrary argv. Each source/owner/terminal capture is separately funded single H8+remote uncertainty8 and create-only intent; no retry.
